external_corpus.note: Cloned for local fixture reconnaissance only; this smoke run did not fuzz this corpus.

runs.suite: paired ERC-20 owner-mint positive and negative controls

properties: unauthorized vulnerable mint increases attacker balance and totalSupply
unauthorized safe mint reverts and preserves attacker balance and totalSupply
separate_foundry_poc_validation.important_scope: This is a separately authored and executed local Foundry regression/PoC test, not a RustyFuzz-generated PoC artifact; RustyFuzz correctly continues to report poc_validation_status=not_attempted.

runs.interpretation: This pair now has independently replayed explicit invariant evidence for the vulnerable fixture and a separately executed Foundry test for the vulnerable/safe properties. It is synthetic local regression evidence, not a real protocol rediscovery.

Local EVM transactions executed and oracle signals were produced. Only positive-erc20-owner-mint has a confirmed predicate proof; the other four cases lack proof confirmation. All PoC validations are not_attempted. These synthetic controls are not real-world rediscoveries.

runs.command: cargo run --quiet --offline --locked -p rusty-fuzz --bin rusty-fuzz -- validate --benchmarks benchmarks/historical/negative_controls --output /tmp/rustyfuzz-negative-controls.json --broker-free
runs.interpretation: All ten local negative controls executed and returned not_found. This is a useful negative-control smoke test, not a peer comparison or production benchmark.

limitations: The positive suite reports per-case local signal status as found while its aggregate production-live found count remains 0; these are different evidence scopes and must not be conflated.
